prompt: Create a final EPIC fantasy whale ANIMATED SPRITE SHEET: 호박빛 향유고래. Reference image 1 is the approved whale IDENTITY and SOFT FANTASY ILLUSTRATION STYLE: match its exact face, body shape, palette, creamy belly, markings and luminous delicate shading; DO NOT make it realistic. Reference image 2 is ONLY a 2x2 POSITION/GRID GUIDE with repeated stills, NOT an animation to copy. Output ONE square transparent PNG containing exactly FOUR equal square cells in a strict 2 columns x 2 rows grid, read top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. NO visible grid or labels. In every cell the SAME complete whale faces RIGHT, with the SAME SCALE and the eye, head and main rigid torso at EXACTLY the SAME cell coordinates. Use fixed face/eye and chest anchor points; DO NOT recenter to chase the tail. Entire silhouette and moving parts stay inside the cell with at least 8% transparent margin on all sides. Smooth four-step slow swimming cycle: frame 0 tail peduncle gently curled upward; frame 1 tail and flukes sweep slightly down/back; frame 2 tail flukes at the lowest point with gentle opposite flex; frame 3 tail recovers upward toward frame 0. Keep the main head/torso completely stable. Pectoral fins softly trail with the water through small connected poses, never alternate giant arm strokes. Long humpback pectorals flow subtly. Distinct real tail/flipper motion is REQUIRED, not four duplicated stills, not brightness-only or blink-only changes. No per-frame zoom, no whole-body bobbing, no color drift or face changes. Keep eyes open and expression consistent. Loop 0-1-2-3-0 naturally. GENUINE ALPHA TRANSPARENCY: there must be ZERO fog, white clouds, haze, halos, detached sparks, particles or colored specks anywhere outside the physical whale. Remove any such artifacts from the identity reference. Crisp smooth colored antialiased contours with no white/black fringe. No background pixels, text, logos or frame. Cell occupancy around 78-84% of width at the widest pose. Preserve beautiful friendly fantasy style from thumbnail, not wildlife realism.
